verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs say the product includes "zero-config anomaly detection" and lets users "detect patterns and outliers with categorization and anomaly detection" on logs. That directly matches surfacing problems without hand-written thresholds, and the nightshift AI SRE is also described as detecting incidents. The evidence is limited to brief marketing-level doc lines. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how anomaly detection jobs are enabled and tuned across metrics/APM, how anomaly results feed alerting rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: This includes zero-config anomaly detection, pattern analysis, and the ability to surface correlations and root causes.
detect patterns and outliers with categorization and anomaly detection
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
